references.text: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan are also mentioned in the list of cities assigned to the tribe of Judah, showing that Simeon's inheritance was within Judah's territory
Explains that Simeon's allotment was within Judah's inheritance, providing context for why these cities are also mentioned in Joshua 15
Ain and Rimmon are mentioned again as cities belonging to the descendants of Simeon in the genealogical record in Chronicles
En-Rimmon is mentioned as a place where the descendants of Judah settled after the exile, showing the city's continued significance
Rimmon is mentioned in Zechariah's prophecy about the future transformation of the land, highlighting the site's geographical importance
